title.so: Muusigga, Warbaahinta iyo Dibadda u Bixidda

swTitle: Muziki, Vyombo vya Habari na Burudani

description.en: Talk about Kenyan music styles, radio, TV and social media, say what you like and what you don't, and make plans to go out.
description.so: Ka hadal noocyada muusigga Kenya, raadiyaha, telefishanka iyo baraha bulshada, sheeg waxaad jeceshahay iyo waxaadan jeclayn, oo qorshee inaad dibadda u baxdo.

body.en: Benga is Kenyan dance music with fast, bright guitar. It was born around Lake Victoria in the 1960s and is now sung in many Kenyan languages. Gengetone is loud Nairobi party rap in Sheng that took off around 2019. Taarab is sung poetry from the coast, with Arabic and Indian influences. Bongo flava comes from Tanzania (Bongo is a nickname for Dar es Salaam and Tanzania) but plays everywhere in Kenya. Gospel is one of the biggest genres in the country.
body.so: Benga waa muusig qoob-ka-ciyaar Kenya ah oo leh gitaar degdeg ah oo cod dhalaalaya. Wuxuu ka dhashay agagaarka harada Fiktooriya 1960-meeyadii, haddana waxaa lagu qaadaa luqado badan oo Kenya ah. Gengetone waa raab xaflado Nairobi oo cod dheer leh oo af Sheng ah, kaas oo caan noqday qiyaastii 2019. Taarab waa gabay la luuqeeyo oo xeebta ka yimid, leh saameyn Carabeed iyo Hindi. Bongo flava waxay ka timid Tanzania (Bongo waa naanaysta Dar es Salaam iyo Tanzania) laakiin meel kasta oo Kenya ah waa laga shidaa. Gospel-ka (heesaha diinta Masiixiga) waa mid ka mid ah noocyada ugu waaweyn dalka.

examples.sw: Bongo flava ni muziki kutoka Tanzania.
examples.en: Bongo flava is music from Tanzania.
examples.so: Bongo flava waa muusig ka yimid Tanzania.

body.en: For online life Kenyans take English verbs and give them Swahili prefixes: kupost (to post), kushare (to share), kutrend (to trend), kudownload. The tenses work as usual: nimepost (I've posted), ameshare (she has shared), inatrend (it's trending). Standard Swahili has its own words too: kupakua (to download), kupakia (to upload), kushiriki (to share).
body.so: Nolosha onlaynka, Kenyaanku waxay qaataan falal Ingiriis ah oo ay siiyaan horgalayaal Sawaaxili: kupost (soo dhigid), kushare (la wadaagid), kutrend (caan noqosho), kudownload. Waqtiyadu sidii caadiga ahayd ayay u shaqeeyaan: nimepost (waan soo dhigay), ameshare (way la wadaagtay), inatrend (waa la wada hadal hayaa). Sawaaxiliga caadiga ahi wuxuu leeyahay erayo u gaar ah: kupakua (soo dejin), kupakia (soo gelin), kushiriki (la wadaagid).

body.en: Radio reaches almost every Kenyan home, in Swahili, English and local languages. Morning shows, listener call-ins and the evening news bulletin (taarifa ya habari) are part of daily life. For television the standard word is runinga, but most people just say TV. A kipindi is any radio or TV programme.
body.so: Raadiyuhu wuxuu gaaraa ku dhawaad guri kasta oo Kenya ah, af Sawaaxili, Ingiriis iyo luqadaha deegaanka. Barnaamijyada subaxa, wicitaannada dhagaystayaasha iyo wararka fiidkii (taarifa ya habari) waa qayb ka mid ah nolol maalmeedka. Telefishanka, erayga caadiga ahi waa runinga, laakiin dadka badankoodu waxay yiraahdaan TV. Kipindi waa barnaamij kasta oo raadiye ama telefishan ah.

body.en: Napenda (I like), sipendi (I don't like), napendelea X kuliko Y (I prefer X to Y). For habits Kenyans use huwa: Huwa nasikiliza redio asubuhi (I usually listen to the radio in the morning). School Swahili also has the hu- form: Mimi husikiliza redio. Mimi ni shabiki wa... means I'm a fan of...
body.so: Napenda (waan jeclahay), sipendi (ma jecli), napendelea X kuliko Y (X ayaan ka jeclahay Y). Caadooyinka, Kenyaanku waxay isticmaalaan huwa: Huwa nasikiliza redio asubuhi (badanaa subaxdii raadiyaha ayaan dhagaystaa). Sawaaxiliga dugsiga wuxuu kaloo leeyahay qaabka hu-: Mimi husikiliza redio. Mimi ni shabiki wa... waxay ka dhigan tahay waxaan taageere u ahay...

examples.sw: Huwa natazama habari saa mbili usiku.
examples.en: I usually watch the news at eight p.m.
examples.so: Badanaa wararka ayaan daawadaa siddeedda habeennimo.

note.en: Plural: nyimbo.
note.so: Wadarta: nyimbo.

note.en: In Kenya msanii usually means a singer or musician. Plural: wasanii.
note.so: Kenya, msanii badanaa waxay ka dhigan tahay fanaan hees qaada ama muusig tuma. Wadarta: wasanii.

items.so: benga (muusig qoob-ka-ciyaar Kenya oo gitaar leh)
gengetone (raab xaflado Nairobi oo af Sheng ah)

note.en: Named after genge, an older Nairobi hip hop style.
note.so: Waxaa loogu magac daray genge, hab hip hop Nairobi oo hore.

items.so: bongo flava (muusig casri ah oo Tanzania ah)

note.en: Tanzanian, not Kenyan, but hugely popular in Kenya too.
note.so: Waa Tanzania, ma aha Kenya, laakiin Kenya-na aad bay caan uga tahay.

items.so: taarab (gabay la luuqeeyo oo xeebta ah)

note.en: Fast Kenyan speech often says kuskiliza. Sikiliza! = Listen!
note.so: Hadalka degdega ah ee Kenya badanaa waa kuskiliza. Sikiliza! = Dhagayso!

note.en: Kuangalia means the same and is very common in Kenya.
note.so: Kuangalia isla macnaha ayay leedahay, Kenya-na aad bay ugu badan tahay.

note.en: Most Kenyans just say TV (tivii). Runinga is the word you hear on Swahili news.
note.so: Kenyaanka badankoodu waxay yiraahdaan TV (tivii). Runinga waa erayga laga maqlo wararka Sawaaxiliga.

note.en: Plural: vipindi. It also means a period of time: kipindi cha mvua (the rainy season).
note.so: Wadarta: vipindi. Sidoo kale waxay ka dhigan tahay muddo: kipindi cha mvua (xilliga roobka).

note.en: Habari alone also means news: Umesikia habari? = Have you heard the news?
note.so: Habari keligeed sidoo kale waa war: Umesikia habari? = Ma maqashay warka?

items.en: What kind of music do you like?

note.en: Napendelea X kuliko Y = I prefer X to Y. From kupenda (to like).
note.so: Napendelea X kuliko Y = X ayaan ka jeclahay Y. Waxay ka timid kupenda (jeclaan).

note.en: Shabiki = fan; plural mashabiki. It works for music, football or anything else.
note.so: Shabiki = taageere; wadarta mashabiki. Waxay u shaqaysaa muusigga, kubadda cagta ama wax kasta.

items.en: I don't really like that kind

note.en: Many Kenyans just say gospel. You hear it in matatus, shops and homes.
note.so: Kenyaan badan waxay yiraahdaan gospel. Waxaad ku maqlaysaa matatu-yada, dukaamada iyo guryaha.

items.en: I usually listen to the radio in the morning

note.en: Huwa + verb = usually. School Swahili also uses hu-: Mimi husikiliza redio asubuhi.
note.so: Huwa + fal = badanaa. Sawaaxiliga dugsiga wuxuu kaloo isticmaalaa hu-: Mimi husikiliza redio asubuhi.

note.en: Lit. social networks. In speech many people just say social media.
note.so: Macnaha: shabakadaha bulshada. Hadalka, dad badan waxay yiraahdaan social media.

note.en: The opposite, to upload, is kupakia. In everyday talk: kudownload.
note.so: Ka soo horjeedka, soo gelin, waa kupakia. Hadalka maalinlaha ah: kudownload.

note.en: Nimepost = I've posted. Standard: kuweka mtandaoni (to put online).
note.so: Nimepost = waan soo dhigay. Caadiga: kuweka mtandaoni (onlayn dhigid).

note.en: Standard: kushiriki.
note.so: Caadiga: kushiriki.

note.en: Inatrend = it's trending. Kenyans online are famous for making topics trend.
note.so: Inatrend = waa la wada hadal hayaa. Kenyaanka onlaynka waxay caan ku yihiin inay mawduucyo caan ka dhigaan.

note.en: Singular: mfuasi. Ana wafuasi wengi = She has lots of followers.
note.so: Keli: mfuasi. Ana wafuasi wengi = Dad badan ayaa raacsan.

note.en: Kenyans mix in English out. In Swahili: Tutoke leo usiku? = Shall we go out tonight?
note.so: Kenyaanku waxay ku daraan erayga Ingiriiska out. Sawaaxili: Tutoke leo usiku? = Caawa ma dibadda u baxnaa?

note.en: Any big public show of music, culture or sport. Tamasha la muziki = a music festival.
note.so: Bandhig kasta oo weyn oo muusig, dhaqan ama ciyaar ah. Tamasha la muziki = bandhig muusig.

note.en: Kiingilio ni bure = Entry is free.
note.so: Kiingilio ni bure = Gelitaanku waa bilaash.

note.en: Kenyans say densi; dictionaries write dansi.
note.so: Kenyaanku waxay yiraahdaan densi; qaamuusyadu waxay qoraan dansi.

note.en: In school Swahili ngoma is a drum or a traditional dance; young Kenyans use it for any song.
note.so: Sawaaxiliga dugsiga, ngoma waa durbaan ama cayaar dhaqameed; dhallinyarada Kenya waxay u isticmaalaan hees kasta.

note.en: The opposite: Punguza sauti (turn it down).
note.so: Ka soo horjeedka: Punguza sauti (codka dhimi).

note.en: From kubamba (to thrill). Sherehe ilibamba = The party was great. Very informal.
note.so: Waxay ka timid kubamba (xiisaha kicin). Sherehe ilibamba = Xafladdu way fiicnayd. Aad bay u fudud tahay.

note.en: Lit. it's fire. Used for a great song, outfit or match.
note.so: Macnaha: waa dab. Waxaa loo isticmaalaa hees, labbis ama ciyaar aad u fiican.

lines.sw: Amina, unasikiliza nini?
lines.en: Amina, what are you listening to?
lines.so: Amina, maxaad dhagaysanaysaa?

lines.sw: Ni taarab kutoka Mombasa. Na wewe?
lines.en: It's taarab from Mombasa. And you?
lines.so: Waa taarab ka timid Mombasa. Adiguna?

lines.sw: Mimi napenda benga. Baba yangu alinifundisha.
lines.en: I like benga. My father taught me.
lines.so: Anigu benga ayaan jeclahay. Aabbahay ayaa i baray.

lines.sw: Na gengetone je?
lines.en: And what about gengetone?
lines.so: Gengetone-se?

lines.sw: Hapana, kelele nyingi sana!
lines.en: No, way too much noise!
lines.so: Maya, buuq aad u badan!

meaning.en: Bongo flava is music from Tanzania.
meaning.so: Bongo flava waa muusig ka yimid Tanzania.

options: Napenda wasanii wa benga na taarab.

explain.en: 'Which artists do you like?' – 'I like benga and taarab artists.'
explain.so: 'Fannaaniintee ayaad jeceshahay?' – 'Waxaan jeclahay fannaaniinta benga iyo taarab.'

lines.sw: Kila asubuhi, Mzee Wafula anaamka saa kumi na moja.
lines.en: Every morning, Mzee Wafula wakes up at five.
lines.so: Subax kasta, Mzee Wafula wuxuu toosaa shanta subaxnimo.

lines.sw: Anawasha redio na kusikiliza habari.
lines.en: He turns on the radio and listens to the news.
lines.so: Wuxuu shidaa raadiyaha oo dhagaystaa wararka.

lines.sw: Kisha anasikiliza kipindi cha muziki wa benga.
lines.en: Then he listens to a benga music programme.
lines.so: Kadib wuxuu dhagaystaa barnaamij muusigga benga ah.

lines.sw: Mjukuu wake, Baraka, anapenda runinga zaidi.
lines.en: His grandson, Baraka, prefers television.
lines.so: Baraka, oo ah wiilka wiilkiisa, telefishanka ayuu ka jecel yahay.

lines.sw: Jioni, wanatazama taarifa ya habari pamoja saa mbili usiku.
lines.en: In the evening they watch the news together at eight p.m.
lines.so: Fiidkii, wararka ayay wada daawadaan siddeedda habeennimo.

lines.sw: Runinga ni nzuri, lakini redio ni rafiki yangu wa zamani.
lines.en: TV is good, but the radio is my old friend.
lines.so: Telefishanku wuu fiican yahay, laakiin raadiyuhu waa saaxiibkaygii hore.

question.en: What does Mzee Wafula listen to first every morning?
question.so: Mzee Wafula subax kasta marka hore maxuu dhagaystaa?

question.en: When do they watch the news together?

explain.en: 'Have you heard today's news?' – 'Yes, I heard it on the radio.'
explain.so: 'Ma maqashay wararka maanta?' – 'Haa, raadiyaha ayaan ka maqlay.'

meaning.en: Every evening we watch the news together.
meaning.so: Fiid kasta wararka ayaan wada daawannaa.

lines.sw: Baraka, unapenda muziki wa aina gani?
lines.en: Baraka, what kind of music do you like?
lines.so: Baraka, muusig noocee ah ayaad jeceshahay?

lines.sw: Napenda muziki wa injili sana. Na wewe?
lines.en: I really like gospel music. And you?
lines.so: Aad baan u jeclahay muusigga gospel-ka. Adiguna?

lines.sw: Napendelea taarab. Huwa nasikiliza kila jioni.
lines.en: I prefer taarab. I usually listen every evening.
lines.so: Taarab ayaan door bidaa. Badanaa fiid kasta ayaan dhagaystaa.

lines.sw: Taarab? Sipendi sana aina hiyo, lakini nitajaribu.
lines.en: Taarab? I don't really like that kind, but I'll give it a try.
lines.so: Taarab? Noocaas aad uma jecli, laakiin waan isku dayi doonaa.

lines.sw: Sawa! Nitakutumia wimbo mmoja.
lines.en: Okay! I'll send you one song.
lines.so: Hagaag! Hal hees ayaan kuu soo diri doonaa.

options.so: Hees ayay Baraka u diri doontaa

meaning.en: I usually listen to the radio every morning.
meaning.so: Badanaa subax kasta raadiyaha ayaan dhagaystaa.

lines.sw: Zawadi ni mwanafunzi Eldoret, na anapenda kupika.
lines.en: Zawadi is a student in Eldoret, and she loves cooking.
lines.so: Zawadi waa arday ku nool Eldoret, waxayna jeceshahay cunto karinta.

lines.sw: Jumamosi moja, alipika chapati na kurekodi video fupi.
lines.en: One Saturday, she cooked chapati and recorded a short video.
lines.so: Sabti ka mid ah, waxay karisay chapati oo duubtay fiidiyow gaaban.

lines.sw: Alipost video hiyo kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.
lines.en: She posted the video on social media.
lines.so: Fiidiyowgaas waxay soo dhigtay baraha bulshada.

lines.sw: Wenzake wa shule waliisambaza, na watu wengi wakaanza kuitazama.
lines.en: Her schoolmates shared it, and lots of people started watching it.
lines.so: Asxaabteeda dugsiga ayaa faafiyey, dad badanna waxay bilaabeen inay daawadaan.

lines.sw: Siku iliyofuata, video yake ilikuwa inatrend kote Kenya.
lines.en: The next day, her video was trending all over Kenya.
lines.so: Maalintii xigtay, fiidiyowgeeda ayaa Kenya oo dhan laga hadal hayay.

lines.sw: Sasa ana wafuasi elfu kumi.
lines.en: Now she has ten thousand followers.
lines.so: Hadda waxaa raacsan toban kun oo qof.

lines.sw: Nimefurahi sana! Wiki ijayo nitapost video ya mandazi.
lines.en: I'm so happy! Next week I'll post a mandazi video.
lines.so: Aad baan u faraxsanahay! Toddobaadka soo socda fiidiyow mandazi ah ayaan soo dhigi doonaa.

question.en: What did Zawadi cook in her video?
How many followers does she have now?
What will her next video be about?
question.so: Fiidiyowgeeda xiga maxuu ku saabsanaan doonaa?

meaning.en: I've downloaded a new benga song.
meaning.so: Hees benga ah oo cusub ayaan soo dejiyey.

lines.sw: Wikendi hii kuna tamasha la muziki Kasarani. Twende!
lines.en: This weekend there's a music festival at Kasarani. Let's go!
lines.so: Dhammaadka toddobaadkan bandhig muusig ayaa Kasarani ka dhacaya. Aan tagno!

lines.sw: Kiingilio ni pesa ngapi?
lines.en: How much is the entry fee?
lines.so: Lacagta gelitaanku waa immisa?

lines.sw: Ni shilingi mia tano. Kutakuwa na benga na nyimbo za injili.
lines.en: It's five hundred shillings. There will be benga and gospel songs.
lines.so: Waa shan boqol oo shilin. Waxaa jiri doona benga iyo heesaha gospel-ka.

lines.sw: Poa! Burudani nzuri. Nitakuja na dada yangu.
lines.en: Cool! Good entertainment. I'll come with my sister.
lines.so: Fiican! Madadaalo wanaagsan. Walaashay ayaan la iman doonaa.

lines.sw: Sawa, tukutane saa nane.
lines.en: Okay, let's meet at two.
lines.so: Hagaag, aan ku kulanno labada.

question.en: How much is the entry fee?

explain.en: 'Shall we go out tonight?' – 'Sorry, I have work early tomorrow.'
explain.so: 'Caawa ma dibadda u baxnaa?' – 'Waan ka xumahay, berri shaqo goor hore ah ayaan leeyahay.'

meaning.en: Entry is free, you don't need to pay.
meaning.so: Gelitaanku waa bilaash, uma baahnid inaad lacag bixiso.

explain.en: 'This song is lit!' – 'Yes, turn it up!'
explain.so: 'Heestani waa cajiib!' – 'Haa, codka kor u qaad!'

lines.sw: Sherehe hii inabamba!
lines.en: This party is lit!
lines.so: Xafladdani waa cajiib!

lines.sw: Ndio! Ngoma hii ni moto. Ongeza sauti!
lines.en: Yes! This song is fire. Turn it up!
lines.so: Haa! Heestani waa dab. Codka kor u qaad!

lines.sw: Siwezi, majirani watalalamika.
lines.en: I can't, the neighbours will complain.
lines.so: Ma awoodo, deriskii way cabanayaan.

lines.sw: Basi weka ngoma ya taarab, pole pole.
lines.en: Then put on a taarab song, nice and soft.
lines.so: Markaa hees taarab ah shid, si tartiib ah.

question.en: Why won't Mutua turn the volume up?
question.so: Maxaa Mutua u diiday inuu codka kor u qaado?

meaning.en: This song is fire! Turn it up.
meaning.so: Heestani waa dab! Codka kor u qaad.
